description: CANOPé CArtographie, fonctionnalités de Nurserie et de protection contre l’érOsion côtière des récifs de Posidonie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office français de la biodiversité. The CANOPé programme, dedicated to mapping, the study of nursery functions and protection against coastal erosion of Posidonia reefs, and their vulnerability to global changes, is a multidisciplinary research programme dedicated to the study of Posidonia reefs in the French Mediterranean. Coverage: Office français de la biodiversité. The portal shows the English title as "CANOPé CArtography, features of nursery and protection against coastal erosion of Posidonia reefs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Office français de la biodiversité. Its keywords include habitats, sites-proteges, biologie, mediterranee, inspire. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
